snippet.title: Nexus: Eternal Ruin - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivors-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

Demo on Steam: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
